extension.summary: Rivulet: watch Stremio-protocol catalogs, addons and streams in Kodi
extension.description: Rivulet is a Kodi client for the Stremio addon protocol: browse and search catalogs by type, install community Stremio addons from a manifest URL, resolve streams and play them back through an embedded or remote rivulet-engine streaming server, and optionally sync your addon collection with your Stremio account.
extension.disclaimer: This addon does not host, index or provide any media content. It is a client for third-party Stremio addons that you install yourself.
extension.news: v0.48.0: - New: live channels show what is on now and next, with times, progress and the programme description, on the Live tab, in lists and in search. Add a programme guide address in Settings, Server add-ons, Live TV, IPTV guide URLs. - New: selecting a channel plays it straight away; a channel with several sources opens the source list. - New: a Recent channels row at the top of the Live tab, with what is on now; remove a channel from it with the context menu. - Changed: channels show as square logo cards, and the logo no longer stretches across the background. - Changed: live channels no longer appear in Continue and are never marked watched, as in Stremio. - Changed: IPTV playlists are sorted by channel number and send the user agent and referrer the playlist asks for. - Fix: changing the IPTV playlist addresses reloads the Live tab without restarting Kodi. - Fix: searching as you type uses less memory and network on slow devices. - Comes with rivulet-engine v0.33.0, installed automatically.
